name: Michael-Eoin Stanney
bio: Michael-Eoin trained at the renowned NYU Tisch Meisner Studio and NYU Tisch Stonestreet Studio for film acting. He completed an acting course at The London Academy of Music and Dramatic Arts, where he studied classical acting techniques and advanced Voice techniques. Michael-Eoin also attended a course at the Lir Academy, Ireland's National Academy of Dramatic Art at Trinity College Dublin, where he was able to further hone his acting skills while being fully immersed in accent training.
